uri.description: AT URI of the site.mochott.article holding the full text: at://{author DID}/site.mochott.article/{rkey}.

main.description: An extra field on an app.bsky.feed.post record, stored under the key 'site.mochott.longPost'. It means the post is the opening of a long post and the full text is the referenced article. The reference must point to a site.mochott.article in the same repository as the post (the post's author); readers must ignore it when the DID differs. The article belongs to the long post: when the post is deleted, mochott deletes the article and its site.standard.document if the author has authorized mochott (see site.mochott.account.getAuthorization).

description: Marks a Bluesky post as the opening of a long post whose full text is a mochott article.
